purpose: Fix the current UI target-form issues: clipped viewport, protruding zones, weak control-cabin feeling, weak identity, insufficient UX proof markers.
layout_laws: The app must fit inside a desktop window without page-level clipping.
Hero must be compact enough to leave room for controls.
Navigation, room content and Aquarium must live in a cockpit frame.
Large pages should use internal scroll zones, not break the whole window.
Cards must not force horizontal overflow.
UX controls must leave aquarium proof markers.
truth_law: UI renders truth; receipts prove truth.
UX action proof is not execution proof.
Patch run button may request a backend run, but cannot claim a successful patch without receipt.
